product_title: Handcrafted Floral Pearl Tealight Holder Set of 6
product_description: Elevate your festive decor with this handcrafted set of six tealight holders, featuring vibrant pink roses, golden metal holders, delicate pearl borders, and elegant golden embellishments. Perfect for Diwali, pooja decor, festive table styling, and special occasions.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep artificial flowers and pearls away from direct heat.
Use LED tealights for safer lighting around floral decorations.
Store in a dry, protective box when not in use.
